brief.title: Global Internet Usage: A Cross-Country Comparison
brief.one_liner: A data-driven comparison of internet penetration, digital population size, and online behavior across the world's leading digital economies.
brief.goal: Viewers should understand how internet adoption varies across major countries and regions, identify the largest digital populations, and recognize key trends shaping global connectivity in 2025.

sections.title: The World's Digital Population
sections.objective: Present the scale of global internet users and highlight the top countries by online population size.

sections.title: Internet Penetration Rates by Country
sections.objective: Compare internet penetration as a percentage of population across selected countries to show disparities in connectivity.

sections.title: How People Spend Time Online
sections.objective: Illustrate daily social media usage trends and the dominant platforms driving engagement worldwide.

sections.title: The Digital Economy Impact
sections.objective: Connect internet usage to economic outcomes such as e-commerce revenue and digital market growth.
